channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Quem dormiu antes de Kassab venceu o 'debate' presidencial
item.description: The Band presidential debate highlighted the absence of frontrunners like Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, leaving empty pulpits as the most striking scene. The edition was shortened due to low declared voting intentions on the network.

item.title: Após debate Band/Estadão, Caiado critica polarização fomentada por Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Following the Band/Estadão debate, Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized political polarization, blaming Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). He questioned how Congress can pass legislation amid such a divisive climate.

item.title: Kassab diz, após debate Band/Estadão, que Caiado critica tanto Lula quanto Flávio
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, running for vice president with the PSD, stated after the Band/Estado debate that federal deputy Ronaldo Caiado criticizes both Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Governor Flávio Dino, suggesting an unaligned stance toward either national leader.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 5 pontos de vantagem na disputa com Lula em São Paulo, mostra pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 38% against Lula (PT) at 33% in the first round in São Paulo, with a five-point advantage. In the second round, the scenario evens out, with a technical tie within the margin of error, keeping Flávio numerically ahead.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: com 49%, Lula passa a ser mais rejeitado que Flávio, com 48%
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows that Lula leads first-round voting intentions but is the most rejected candidate at 49%, surpassing Flávio Bolsonaro (48%). In the second round, there is a technical tie between Lula and his main opponents.

item.title: O salto nos pedidos de reconhecimento de vínculo de emprego
item.description: Requests for employment bond recognition nearly tripled from 168,000 in 2020 to 471,000 in 2025, according to CNJ data. Delays in Supreme Court rulings on 'Uberization' and 'contracting' generate legal insecurity, worsening labor litigation. In an election year, Congress is unlikely to address the issue.

item.title: Lula supera Flávio em rejeição pela primeira vez desde abril, mostra nova pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: The latest BTG/Nexus poll shows that, for the first time since April, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has a higher rejection rate (49%) than Flávio Bolsonaro (48%), though the 1-point difference is within the margin of error. Despite this, Lula maintains a lead in voting potential, with 50% of respondents saying they would vote for him exclusively or among other options, compared to 47% for Flávio.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam no 2º turno, mostra nova pesquisa Nexus/BTG
item.description: A new Nexus/BTG poll reveals a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a potential second round of the 2026 presidential election. The survey also shows Lula leading decisively against Romeu Zema (Novo), Renan Santos (Missão), and tying with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD). The poll was conducted between August 21 and 23 with 2,006 phone interviews and a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Onde Lula vence Flávio — e onde Flávio supera Lula — no segundo turno, segundo nova pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: A new BTG/Nexus poll shows Lula at 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 45% in a potential runoff, with the race remaining statistically tied. Voting preferences vary widely across gender, religion, region, and income, highlighting a deeply polarized electorate.

item.title: 50% veem possibilidade de interferência estrangeira nas eleições
item.description: Datafolha poll shows 50% of voters believe foreign interference in the 2026 elections is possible, with 32% viewing it as a problem and 18% not. The survey, filed with TSE, reveals notable differences between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro supporters, amid diplomatic tensions between Brazil, US and Argentina.

item.title: Flávio lidera disputa em SP com 38%, diz pesquisa Real Time Big Data
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads surveyed voting intentions in São Paulo with 38%, followed by Lula (PT) at 33%. In a simulated runoff, Lula leads 49% to 44%. Survey of 2,000 voters conducted August 19–22 with a ±2 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Nexus/BTG indica cenário apertado no 1º turno das eleições presidenciais
item.description: New Nexus/BTG poll shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of the 2026 presidential election, with 41% and 37% respectively in the first scenario. In a second scenario with Pablo Marçal, Lula leads with 40% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 34%, maintaining an advantage above the ±2 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Real Time Big Data: Tarcísio tem 52% contra 35% de Haddad pelo governo
item.description: The Real Time Big Data survey shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading with 52% of voting intentions, against 35% for Fernando Haddad (PT) in the race for governor of São Paulo. The 17-point lead indicates a first-round victory, with 63% approval for Tarcísio's administration.

item.title: Tarcísio tem 17 pontos de vantagem na disputa com Haddad, mostra pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data shows that Sao Paulo governor Tarcisio de Freitas leads the race with a 17-point advantage over Fernando Haddad. The poll projects Tarcisio to win reelection in the first round with 52% of the votes.

item.title: Gusttavo Lima ignora vaias a Lula em Barretos, mas Globo exibe ‘climão’
item.description: During Gusttavo Lima's show in Barretos, part of the audience booed President Lula, but TV Globo did not broadcast the incident live. The singer, a Bolsonaro supporter, has endorsed the former president and once considered a 2026 presidential run but withdrew.

item.title: Saiba o que os candidatos ao Planalto farão nesta 2ª feira
item.description: Presidential candidates carry out official meetings and campaign events on August 24, 2026, highlighting interactions with economic leaders, ministers, and media interviews. Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, Zema, and Cury show varied schedules covering governance, productive sector engagement, and media presence. The programming reflects the advance of pre-campaigns with emphasis on economic and institutional matters.

item.title: Agenda de Lula: leia os compromissos do presidente nesta 2ª feira
item.description: President Lula has an official work schedule in Brasília on Monday, with meetings at Palácio do Alvorada and Palácio do Planalto. His commitments include meetings with advisors and ministers, as well as participation in the Contrata+Brasil event alongside Vice President Alckmin. The agenda reflects a focus on public management and ministerial relations.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas eleitorais podem sair nesta 2ª feira
item.description: Electoral polls registered with the TSE were authorized for release on Monday, August 24, 2026, covering electoral scenarios in 17 states and the Federal District. Disclosure depends on regulatory deadlines and contractor approval, with data accessible through the Poder360 Research Aggregator.

item.title: Governo Lula: leia a agenda de ministros do governo nesta 2ª feira
item.description: Ministers from President Lula's government carry out their work agenda in Brasília and via videoconference on Monday (24th). Key activities include meetings with the president at the Planalto, a session of the National Monetary Council, and the launch of a mental health service. The Chief of Staff, Finance, and Planning ministries lead the main movements of the day.

item.title: A boa notícia para Flávio Bolsonaro contra Lula na nova pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: The latest BTG/Nexus poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro narrowing the gap with Lula, cutting the margin to just 1 point in the second round and 4 points in the first round. While within the margin of error, the movements suggest increasing competitiveness.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: Lula estabiliza, e Flávio oscila para cima nos dois turnos
item.description: BTG Nexus survey shows Lula with 38% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 31% in first-round voting intentions. In the second round, Lula remains stable while Flávio surges upward, becoming the main opponent to the PT candidate.

item.title: Lula tem 46% contra 45% de Flávio no 2º turno, diz BTG/Nexus
item.description: A poll by BTG/Nexus released on August 24, 2026 shows that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 46% of voting intentions in a hypothetical second round against senator Flávio Bolsonardo (PL-RJ), who scored 45%. The result reflects a tight and dynamic scenario for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula tem 46% e Flávio Bolsonaro registra 45% em cenário de 2º turno, mostra pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: BTG/Nexus poll shows Lula at 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 45% in a hypothetical runoff, within the margin of error. Both remain technically tied, with 8% undecided or null votes. Lula also leads in simulations against Caiado and Zema.

item.title: Veja imagens do condomínio em que vive Lulinha na Espanha
item.description: Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), the eldest son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has resided in a luxury condominium in Madrid since 2025. The monthly rent of approximately $35,000 raises questions about his income sources, amid scandals involving INSS fraud and congressional investigations. He established a technology company in 2026, but it remains inactive.

item.title: Lulinha é vizinho de Vini Junior e Rodrygo, do Real, em Madri
item.description: The eldest son of President Lula, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, resides in one of Madrid's most luxurious neighborhoods, alongside Real Madrid players, contradicting Washington Quaquá's claims of poor living conditions. Despite living in a high-standard property, it remains unclear how he affords the housing costs in Spain, given that his company appears to be inactive.

item.title: A nova pesquisa BTG/Nexus sobre a disputa Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro após início da campanha
item.description: The new BTG/Nexus poll shows a tight race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential second round, with Lula holding a thin 1-point lead (46% to 45%). Voting preferences vary significantly by gender, region, and age, with Lula strong among women and in the Northeast, while Flávio leads among men and in the South.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro têm empate técnico em 1º e 2º turnos
item.description: The BTG/Nexus survey reveals a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in both the first and second rounds, with Lula maintaining a slight numerical advantage outside the margin of error. The survey also shows Lula tied technically with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) in the second round.

item.title: Imagem de Flávio perde espaço para Michelle e Nikolas em peças de candidatos da direita
item.description: Right-wing candidates, especially those from the PL party, have prioritized the image of Nikolas Ferreira and Michelle Bolsonaro in campaign materials, sidelining Flávio Bolsonaro, which has caused dissatisfaction within the presidential candidate's team. The preference stems from Nikolas's large social media reach and electoral appeal, with 22.1 million Instagram followers—nearly double Flávio's 11.3 million.

item.title: Jogos de hoje, segunda, 24 de agosto: onde assistir futebol ao vivo e horários
item.description: Monday, August 24, concludes an eventful round of football matches across the Premier League, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Saudi Arabia. In Brazil, Botafogo vs. Athletico-PR stands out in the Brasileirão, while Série B matches fill out the schedule.

item.title: 9 deputados investigados no STF têm aumento de R$ 33,9 milhões em bens
item.description: Nine federal deputies under investigation at the STF increased their assets by R$33.9 million between the last election and 2024, according to a UOL survey. The investigations suspect embezzlement of parliamentary amendments and funds. The asset growth raises concerns about the origin of the resources.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se une a 'inimigos' de Lula como estratégia para Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign focuses on the Northeast, strengthening opponents of Lula (PT) and candidates backed by him, even if it means not integrating local rallies. The strategy aims to consolidate state-level support without relying on direct alliances with regional leaders.

item.title: QG de Lula vai ao TSE contra ação 'coordenada e inautêntica' sobre preços
item.description: Lula's campaign requests a TSE investigation into suspected mass dissemination of inauthentic material, including scripts and identical images, promoted by profiles linked to PL leaders criticizing food prices.

item.title: Lula vai aparecer no horário eleitoral com livros que leu na prisão
item.description: Lula recorded new campaign ads for the electoral time slot, to air starting August 28, featuring a bookshelf with over 40 books he read during his 2018-2019 imprisonment in Curitiba. The recordings were made at the campaign's new headquarters in Brasília, covering topics like the 'Blusinhas Tax' and works on history, sociology, and historical figures like Nelson Mandela and Fidel Castro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro critica Lula e diz qual seria um de seus 'primeiros atos' caso vença as eleições
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a social media video, blaming the federal government for family debt, rising food prices, and violence in the country. If elected president, he said one of his first acts would be 'to decree that Brazil belongs to the Lord Jesus Christ'. The senator also referenced Federal Police investigations involving Lula's son and former chief of staff Marcola.

item.title: Dark Horse: O que a PF quer saber da Ancine sobre polêmico filme de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police gave Ancine 10 days to provide information about the controversial film 'Dark Horse' linked to Jair Bolsonaro. The investigation is under Supreme Court justice André Mendonça's review.

item.title: 'Vai votar em quem?': denúncias de assédio eleitoral no trabalho chegam a 119 e superam em 16,4% eleições passadas
item.description: Workplace electoral harassment complaints reached 119 cases between January and July 2026, a 16.4% increase compared to the same period in 2024. Municipal employees in Monte Alegre, Pará, reported pressure from a local councilman to support a pre-candidate, with dismissal threats. The practice is widespread across most Brazilian states and has been tracked by labor courts since 2023.

item.title: Nome de operação da PF contra Lulinha incomoda entorno de Lula
item.description: The Federal Police named a phase of investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and Roberta Luchsinger 'Operation Elli,' causing discomfort around Lula due to a perceived reference to the phrase 'Faz o L.' The operation investigates alleged money laundering and capital laundering crimes involving businessmen and lobbyists.

item.title: Lula diz que Lulinha deve ser investigado e punido se tiver cometido erros
item.description: In an interview with TV Record, President Lula stated that his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), should be investigated and punished if any wrongdoing is proven, emphasizing that investigations are proceeding normally at the Supreme Federal Court. Lulinha faces probes related to alleged lobbying misconduct and influence peddling.

item.title: Governo Lula decide incluir previsão de receita de tributos criados pela Reforma Tributária no Orçamento de 2027
item.description: The Lula government decided to include revenue projections for the new Contribution on Goods and Services (CBS) and the Selective Tax (IS) in the 2027 Budget Proposal, following the Tax Reform. The decision aims to support the reform operationally but may be politically exploited by opponents such as Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado. The government has not yet set the timeline for sending the Provisional Measure to enable the Selective Tax in 2027.

item.title: Kassab reage a ausências no primeiro debate presidencial de 2026
item.description: Gilberto Kassab criticized the absence of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema from the first 2026 presidential debate, attributing the no-show of the first two to a strategy to protect their polling lead. Regarding Zema, Kassab considered it a mistake to run for president and suggested he should instead run for the Senate.

item.title: Este filme já passou e no fim o bandido morre. Mas se não morrer?
item.description: The article examines Flávio Bolsonaro's political trajectory, highlighting his shift from a supposedly moderate image to a hardline, anti-establishment stance, promoting draconian punishments and undermining democratic institutions. It warns how bolsonarism exploits public frustration to gain ground, even after consecutive electoral defeats.

item.title: Lula intensifica aceno às mulheres em contraponto a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula intensifies outreach to women with a meeting in Belo Horizonte, while Flávio Bolsonaro faces criticism for allegedly macho positions. A Quaest survey shows Lula leading among female voters (47% vs 35%).

item.title: Propostas de Lula sobre crime organizado seguem emperradas nos EUA
item.description: Cooperation proposals between Brazil and the US on fighting organized crime, presented by Lula to Trump in May, remain unanswered. Despite a phone call on August 21 where Trump expressed willingness, no concrete decisions were made. The issue is prominent in bilateral relations, alongside trade tensions.

item.title: Em debate esvaziado, Lula é citado 40 vezes, a cada 2 minutos em média
item.description: In the first 2026 presidential debate hosted by Band, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was mentioned 40 times on average every two minutes, despite not attending. Candidates Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos and Augusto Cury criticized his absence, with Renan labeling him a coward. Flávio Bolsonaro was also attacked, while Romeu Zema was not referenced at all.

item.title: Quem ganhou o primeiro debate presidencial?
item.description: The first presidential debate, hosted by TV Bandeirantes, saw low participation with only three candidates: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão), and Augusto Cury (Avante). Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema did not attend. Despite the limited presence, Renan Santos stood out the most, according to analysts, by leveraging the platform to increase his visibility.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta segunda (23/8)
item.description: On Monday (24/8), seven candidates for São Paulo's 2026 gubernatorial election continue their campaign schedules. Front-runners Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad lead activities including town halls and debates, while other candidates focus on internal strategy meetings and campaign video recordings.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lança TV para reforçar artilharia digital contra Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) 2026 presidential campaign will launch a 24-hour YouTube channel to boost digital strategies against Lula. The initiative starts with TV and radio ads from Friday (28).

item.title: Após descoberta de petróleo, Alcolumbre é tratado como sheik
item.description: The confirmation of oil in the Amazon mouth strengthened Davi Alcolumbre's position in Congress, where he was nicknamed 'sheikh' by allies. Exploitation could generate billions in royalties and boost Amapá's economy, but creates tensions with environmental ministers. Alcolumbre maintains alliances with LULA and FLÁVIO BOLSONARO, consolidating his political power.

item.title: A comparação entre Mendonça e Moraes por uma ala do STF
item.description: The office of Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça signals likely rejection of the Attorney General's request to send two investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva to a lower court. The stance reflects internal judicial divergence regarding the handling of politically sensitive cases.

item.title: Fala espanhol? Compare Chile e Uruguai e descubra onde vale mais a pena morar
item.description: Chile and Uruguay are attractive destinations for Brazilians looking to live abroad, due to the shared language, high quality of life, and easy immigration through Mercosul. Uruguay stands out in safety and wages, while Chile has the highest HDI in the region.
